title: Us, Our Pets and the War (Cat & Dog)

title_lang.en: Us, Our Pets and the War (Cat & Dog)

synopsis: From the heart of war-torn Ukraine, animals are left behind by those forced to flee. From cats and dogs in bombarded buildings to lions and tigers in empty zoos, extraordinary rescue efforts are underway to bring them to safety. Stories of survival, love, and resilience emerge beyond the battles. Every rescued animal becomes a beam of hope and soothe our broken hearts. In the end, the line between rescuer and rescued begins to blur.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 俄烏戰爭爆發，家園盡毀。數不清的動物因主人匆忙撤離，被困於頹垣敗瓦中，在缺水缺糧的極端狀況下苦苦掙扎無數日與夜。一場大規模的動物救援隨即展開，鑽開牆壁將水注入不見天日的密室，鋸開門鎖拯救氣若游絲的動物。從衝進動物收容所營救貓狗，到闖進動物園撤離猛獸，一眾志願者奮不顧身守護每一條生命。在最嚴峻的環境當中，每一隻獲救的動物，都化作一道曙光。究竟，是我們拯救了牠們，還是牠們救贖了我們？
